name: Hunter
description:
Hunter is an American police drama television series created by Frank Lupo, and starring Fred Dryer as Sgt. Rick Hunter and Stepfanie Kramer as Sgt. Dee Dee McCall, which ran on NBC from 1984 to 1991. However, Kramer left after the sixth season to pursue other acting and musical opportunities. In the seventh season, Hunter partnered with two different women officers. The titular character, Sgt. Rick Hunter, was a wily, physically imposing, and often rule-breaking homicide detective with the Los Angeles Police Department. The show's main characters, Hunter and McCall, resolve many of their cases by shooting dead the perpetrators.

The show's executive producer during the first season was Stephen J. Cannell, whose company produced the series.

videos.title: Hunter
videos.overview: Son of a mobster, Detective Sergeant Rick Hunter finds it difficult to keep a partner. The Captain assigns Hunter a new partner, but Hunter has another maverick in mind, Sergeant Dee Dee McCall. Hunter and McCall team up to catch a serial killer.

videos.title: Hard Contract
videos.overview: Hunter & McCall make a pact of protectiveness and loyalty toward each other when she is nearly killed by her old partner after she tries to stop him from a killer-for-hire assignment.

videos.title: The Hot Grounder
videos.overview: After the Commissioner's wife is murdered, Hunter and McCall have to piece together the clues in order to find the true killer.

videos.title: A Long Way From L.A.
videos.overview: A meek "pick-pocket" is accused of brutally beating a woman. Hunter and McCall unconvinced that he could do such a thing have to find the true culprit before it's too late.

videos.title: Legacy
videos.overview: A mobster's girlfriend overhears gunshots after an argument between her boyfriend and his father. Hunter, unable to prove anything with her testimony decides to use her as bait to lure her boyfriend in.

videos.title: Flight on a Dead Pigeon
videos.overview: Hunter and McCall help a small girl who claims her uncle just died and all of his pigeons had been stolen. Upon further investigation into the missing pigeons, Hunter and McCall discover that the girl's uncle was killed.

videos.title: Pen Pals
videos.overview: A notorious drug dealer is killed by a thief who stole Hunter's "backup" gun, returning it immediately after the killing. With Hunter locked up in jail with an inmate planning on killing him, McCall must catch the true killer to clear Hunter's name.

videos.title: Dead or Alive
videos.overview: A bounty hunter tracking two bank robbers crosses paths with Hunter and McCall. After initially letting the bounty hunter go, Hunter and McCall come to realize there is more to pursue.

videos.title: High Bleacher Man
videos.overview: Hunter and McCall are assigned to protect a sleazy criminal, who has been given immunity for fingering a top criminal. Outraged at having to protect him, Hunter and McCall set out to find someone else who can finger the top criminal.

videos.title: The Shooter
videos.overview: A motorcycle cop is killed by a man on a "nighthawk." Upon further investigation, Hunter and McCall discover the killer may have been motivated by a dispute over a western shootout game at a bar.

videos.title: The Garbage Man
videos.overview: A parole officer is killed one night after meeting with a parolee. When the parolee confesses that he was not the killer, Hunter and McCall must track down a killer who has been shooting parolees.

videos.title: The Avenging Angel
videos.overview: A mentally disturbed surveillance expert attempts to "help" Hunter by killing a suspect and a witness. McCall is kidnapped when the surveillance expert is unhappy that Hunter does not approve of his actions.

videos.title: The Snow Queen (1)
videos.overview: A cocaine dealer being escorted by an obnoxious detective escapes. Hunter and the detective pursue her, meanwhile, McCall goes undercover to bring down a drug lord.

videos.title: The Snow Queen (2)
videos.overview: The pursuit of the cocaine dealer continues and the plot thickens as Hunter and McCall find their cases colliding.

videos.title: The Beach Boy
videos.overview: The Beach Boy arrives in L.A. from Hawaii and begins to kill local drug dealers. Hunter and McCall have to figure out his next move before another victim is claimed.

videos.title: Guilty
videos.overview: Hunter and McCall go after a convicted murderer who is back out on the street and has vowed to kill the jurors who convicted him.

videos.title: The Last Kill
videos.overview: Hunter and McCall go after a contract killer who is making hits throughout the city in order to ingratiate himself with a criminal kingpin in order to kill him.

videos.title: Fire Man
videos.overview: Hunter and McCall are brought in to help solve an arsonist/murder case. Someone has been setting fires all over the city to empty warehouses.

videos.title: Sniper
videos.overview: Hunter and McCall go after a sniper who is killing blondes that remind him of his wife who jilted him 18 years ago. Meanwhile, the Police Department personnel is being audited by a most efficient IRS Agent.

videos.title: Case X
videos.overview: McCall goes undercover to help Hunter investigate the deaths of two models involved in pornographic films.

videos.title: Night of the Dragons
videos.overview: Hunter and McCall's investigation of a killing in Chinatown leads them to a Chinese gang leader being pursued by a police officer with a personal interest in the case.

videos.title: The Biggest Man in Town
videos.overview: Hunter and McCall go undercover at an exclusive resort to find a blackmailer's killer.

videos.title: Rich Girl
videos.overview: When a millionaire is nearly killed, his wife is the primary heir and prime suspect until she's murdered, prompting Hunter to go undercover to find the real killer.

videos.title: Killer in a Halloween Mask
videos.overview: Hunter and McCall become involved in a string of bizarre murders when they're assigned as technical advisers for a television show.

videos.title: Rape and Revenge (1)
videos.overview: When McCall is raped by a South American diplomat who's immune from prosecution, Hunter turns renegade and follows the man to his homeland.

videos.title: Rape and Revenge (2)
videos.overview: Against departmental orders, Hunter goes to South America to stalk a diplomat who raped McCall.

videos.title: Million Dollar Misunderstanding
videos.overview: A security guard turned thief loses the money he stole, and searches for it with Hunter and McCall in close pursuit.

videos.title: The Big Fall
videos.overview: Hunter and McCall realize they're attracted to each other as they protect an endangered witness who's set to testify before a grand jury.

videos.title: Waiting for Mr. Wrong
videos.overview: Hunter becomes involved with a beautiful model he suspects of complicity in a jewelry robbery.

videos.title: Think Blue
videos.overview: A group of corrupt cops are stealing electronics and murder a street gang member who witnesses their crimes. Meanwhile, Hunter helps a policeman who is framed for the murder of his wife.

videos.title: Blow-up
videos.overview: Hunter is frustrated in his pursuit of a package bomber whose ruthless methods are being used to systematically kill the participants in the man's trial.

videos.title: War Zone
videos.overview: Hunter and McCall work to stop a brigade of suburban mercenaries plotting to break a drug dealer out of prison.

videos.title: Burned
videos.overview: Hunter and McCall are given 72 hours to find an attorney who falsified his death.

videos.title: Scrap Metal
videos.overview: When a dying contract killer confesses he was once paid to kill Hunter's father, Hunter goes in pursuit of the true murderer.

videos.title: Fagin 1986
videos.overview: Hunter and McCall's investigation of a teenager's death leads them to a contemporary Fagin who commands a group of barrio boys to commit crimes for him.

videos.title: 62 Hrs. of Terror
videos.overview: Hunter and McCall are called to investigate the car bombing of a Middle-Eastern consulate member for which a student terrorist group claims responsibility.

videos.title: Death Machine
videos.overview: Hunter investigates a theft that turns to murder when a robbery victim hires a deranged detective to retrieve his stolen jewels.

videos.title: The Setup
videos.overview: Wrongly suspended from the police force for severely beating a suspect, Hunter pursues the gangster who had him discredited.

videos.title: The Beautiful & the Dead (1)
videos.overview: When a dead girl disappears from Hunter's living room, Hunter and McCall follow a trail of intrigue, adultery and murder.

videos.title: The Beautiful & the Dead (2)
videos.overview: Hunter and McCall's continued investigation into adultery and homicide pits them against a group of Russian spies.

videos.title: The Return of Typhoon Thompson
videos.overview: Hunter and Dee Dee get a murder case reopened in order to exonerate a paroled ex-boxer and find the real killer.

videos.title: Saturday Night Special
videos.overview: Hunter and McCall investigate mysterious calls to a reporter about a series of murders.

videos.title: Overnight Sensation
videos.overview: Reporter Raul Mercado has made it his mission to put an end to Hunter's career, putting the detective square in the crosshairs when someone makes an attempt on the reporter's life.

videos.title: Change Partners and Dance
videos.overview: Detectives Hunter and McCall must work individually to investigate the killing of a police officer after their new precinct leader separates them.

videos.title: Crime of Passion
videos.overview: The seemingly straightforward murder of a woman in the middle of an ugly divorce gets complicated when Hunter and McCall discover that the woman's new boyfriend is involved in another terrible crime.

videos.title: The Castro Connection
videos.overview: Hunter and McCall attempt to break a cocaine syndicate, apparently being run by one of Hunter's most trusted ex-partners.

videos.title: High Noon in L.A.
videos.overview: Carlos Mariano, brother of a man Hunter murdered in an act of vengeance, arrives in LA looking for his own revenge against Hunter and McCall.

videos.title: From San Francisco With Love
videos.overview: A beautiful San Francisco police detective aids Hunter and McCall in solving a series of puzzling murders apparently connected to the estate of a deceased millionaire.

videos.title: True Confessions
videos.overview: After a teenage girl dies from a drug overdose during a high school party and the boys who drugged her are released on a technicality, the girl's sister is blamed for the boys' murders.

videos.title: Love, Hate and Sporty James
videos.overview: Hunter and McCall try to protect their long-time informant Sporty James from his own greed after he blackmails a ruthless cocaine dealer.

videos.title: The Contract
videos.overview: A wealthy woman's gardener is killed when he attempts to save her from a kidnapping, putting Hunter's and McCall's suspicions on high alert when her husband quickly pays the ransom and attempts to avoid an investigation after her safe return.

videos.title: The Cradle Will Rock
videos.overview: McCall goes undercover as a dance club singer to solve a murder.

videos.title: Bad Company
videos.overview: Facing off against a gang of Neo-Nazis responsible for a deadly robbery, Hunter and McCall get help from an unlikely ally in their attempt to escape the violent terrorists.

videos.title: Down and Under
videos.overview: Hunter travels to Australia to help solve a murder case involving a former girlfriend who has been missing for three years.

videos.title: Straight to the Heart
videos.overview: Hunter goes on an enforced vacation and falls for a beautiful model staying at his hotel, unaware that she was actually sent to kill him.

videos.title: Requiem for Sergeant McCall
videos.overview: McCall lands in hot water after she reopens the case her husband was working when he was killed.

videos.title: Double Exposure
videos.overview: McCall goes undercover as a model to investigate a modeling agency's shady practices.

videos.title: The Girl Next Door
videos.overview: Hunter and McCall pose as husband and wife to investigate the murder of a young girl whose death exposes a Soviet plot to relocate secret agents in the United States.

videos.title: Any Second Now
videos.overview: In this episode, inspired by the chilling and real-life stalking of Theresa Saldana, a psychopath protected by the technicalities of the law makes a pianist's life a living hell while Hunter and McCall spend their off-duty hours desperately trying to protect the victim.

videos.title: A Child is Born
videos.overview: McCall wants to adopt a baby girl whose mother was shot and left braindead in a case of mistaken identity.

videos.title: Crossfire
videos.overview: McCall fears that Hunter's temper will outweigh his judgement when his former girlfriend is murdered and Hunter thinks he knows the identity of the killer.

videos.title: Hot Pursuit (1)
videos.overview: McCall must fight to survive in surgery after an attempt on her life, while rage-blind Hunter confronts the man he believes is responsible for ordering the hit.

videos.title: Hot Pursuit (2)
videos.overview: Knowing he has the motive, police in Beverly Hills pin the homicide of Big Jack Hemmings on Hunter, but the detective believes he knows the real culprit.

videos.title: Shades
videos.overview: When Hunter disappears during an investigation of organized crime, McCall and her new partner must find him before he's killed.

videos.title: Not Just Another John Doe
videos.overview: When Hunter and McCall investigate the murder of an unidentified man, their interest is piqued because the victim seemingly never existed, and the killing appears to be a professional murder.

videos.title: Playing God
videos.overview: After learning the circumstances leading up to the murder of a notorious Latino crime boss, Hunter and McCallface an ethical dilemma: whether to arrest the killer or let him go free.

videos.title: The Jade Woman
videos.overview: Hunter investigates the disappearance of a friend's mail-order bride while he is off duty. The case becomes a homicide investagation when the marriage broker is murdered.

videos.title: Flashpoint
videos.overview: Racial tensions mount as Hunter and McCall investigate the accidental shooting by the police of Antonio Elandro, the son of a Hispanic councilman.

videos.title: Night on Bald Mountain
videos.overview: When Hunter & McCall travel to a mountaintop mansion to investigate a murder, they are trapped there overnight with the victim's entire family in the midst of a massive snowstorm.

videos.title: City of Passion (1)
videos.overview: Hunter and McCall investigate a series of bizarre murders, which take on the appearance of the result of a Satanic cult rite. Based on a book by Dallas Barnes.

videos.title: City of Passion (2)
videos.overview: A serial rapist known as Big Foot stalks McCall while Hunter investigates the death of a teenage prostitute who may have had ties to a Satanic cult.

videos.title: City of Passion (3)
videos.overview: McCall risks losing her job when she fails to report a felony, and Hunter tries to trap the killer of a teenage prostitute with possible ties to a Satanic cult.

videos.title: Turning Point
videos.overview: When Hunter and McCall investigate the alleged death of reporter Ralph Ormond they uncover an extortion plot involving George Shadwell a wealthy industrialist.

videos.title: Hot Prowl
videos.overview: Hunter and McCall become suspicious when a Bel Air housewife refuses to identify the man who robbed her of a million-dollar necklace.

videos.title: Allegra
videos.overview: Hunter and McCall investigate the mysterious death of Allegra, Hunter's former girlfriend, to determine if the beautiful young heiress jumped or was pushed from a skyscraper window.

videos.title: Renegade
videos.overview: When Hunter investigates a drug ring, his ex-partner, Frank Garriman, becomes a suspect in the murder of the dealers.

videos.title: Black Dahlia
videos.overview: Lawrence Tierney guest stars as Detective Doyle, who comes out of retirement to help Hunter and McCall investigate the real life murder of actress-turned-prostitute Elizabeth Short, who was cut in half 41 years before.

videos.title: Naked Justice (1)
videos.overview: Hunter and McCall investigate the mysterious death of a famous movie actress and encounter a surviving sister hungry for the inheritance.

videos.title: Naked Justice (2)
videos.overview: Hunter, investigating the murder of a famous movie actress, follows a contract killer to Mexico and learns why the C.I.A. is interested in the killing.

videos.title: Girl on the Beach
videos.overview: Captain Devane tries to take Hunter and McCall off the investigation of his ex-wife's murder and violates his forced leave of absence to pursue the killer himself.

videos.title: The Bogota Million
videos.overview: A Colombian drug dealer is murdered, and police informant Sporty James becomes the prime suspect, hunted by both Hunter and the criminals.

videos.title: Death Signs
videos.overview: Hunter and McCall's investigation of the stabbing of a deaf man hinges on cryptic clues the victim gave in sign language before he died.

videos.title: Boomerang
videos.overview: The wife of a businessman who was killed in an explosion on his yacht becomes the prime suspect when Hunter and McCall discover that she was recently removed from his will.

videos.title: The Fourth Man
videos.overview: Hunter and McCall investigate the whereabouts of four million dollars still missing from a six-year-old drug bust that implicates the police in criminal activity.

videos.title: Murder He Wrote
videos.overview: Hunter and McCall investigate the death of a multi-millionaire, whose four heirs become prime suspects.

videos.title: Silver Bullet
videos.overview: The only clue in a series of murders is a trail of police-issued ammunition that leads Hunter and McCall to suspect a colleague as the killer.

videos.title: Heir of Neglect
videos.overview: Hunter investigates the case of a teenage boy who mistakenly shot his parents during what he claimed was a home invasion.

videos.title: The Baby Game
videos.overview: Hunter and McCall enter the world of baby brokering when they find the murdered body of an expensive call girl, and a two-year-old toddler left unharmed in front of the woman's television set.

videos.title: Dead on Target (1)
videos.overview: While investigating the apparent suicide of Hunter's friend from the Vietnam War, Hunter and McCall uncover a twenty-year-old betrayal with a rising body count.

videos.title: Dead on Target (2)
videos.overview: Hunter uncovers a gem-smuggling operation while investigating his war buddy's death.

videos.title: Presumed Guilty
videos.overview: McCall finds her loyalties sharply divided when an important murder case being prosecuted by her lover is jeopardized by Hunter, who thinks the defendant is innocent.

videos.title: No Good Deed Ever Goes Unpunished
videos.overview: Mysterious tape recordings accusing a powerful company of illegally dumping toxic waste seem like a prank, until Hunter and McCall find that someone is willing to kill to conceal the truth.

videos.title: Honorable Profession
videos.overview: Hunter puts his job on the line when he defends a female officer wounded and possibly killed in the line of duty.

videos.title: Payback
videos.overview: Hunter and McCall try to solve a bank robbery and murder, while attempting to cope with the double and triple-crossing schemes of a small time criminal who once saved Hunter's life and won't let him forget it.

videos.title: Partners
videos.overview: When the husband of a policewoman is murdered, evidence of wife abuse makes Hunter and McCall suspect the woman's patrol partner who knew about the beatings.

videos.title: The Pit
videos.overview: The son of an LAPD dispatcher lands himself in hot water when he accumulates gambling debts.

videos.title: City Under Siege (1)
videos.overview: Hunter and McCall track a pair of killers through a Los Angeles suburb where a crime wave and backlash vigilantism threaten to tear the community apart.

videos.title: City Under Siege (2)
videos.overview: An escaped killer continues to stalk Hunter; a desperate vigilante fights crime in his neighborhood.

videos.title: City Under Siege (3)
videos.overview: Hunter nabs an escaped convict after a neighborhood vigilante is found dead.

videos.title: Me, Myself & Die
videos.overview: A woman is the prime suspect in a brutal murder case after she stops taking her experimental medication.

videos.title: Informant
videos.overview: An informant to whom Hunter promised anonymity seven years earlier represents himself when his case is re-tried.

videos.title: Blood Line
videos.overview: Hunter and McCall follow the trail of revenge and fraud while investigating the murder of a thoroughbred racehorse.

videos.title: Shoot to Kill
videos.overview: McCall is suspected of having shot an innocent man during a shootout in an alley and fights to clear her name with help from Hunter and Sporty James. While helping McCall, they discover a ring of jewel thieves.

videos.title: Code 3
videos.overview: When a nurse she recently befriended is killed in a car accident related to alcohol just a few days later, McCall suspects foul play. She is even more convinced of that after learning the nurse was pregnant, and would not have mixed alcohol with the morning sickness medication she was taking.

videos.title: Ring of Honor
videos.overview: When a series of murders hits the prize-fighting community, a boxing trainer helps Hunter and McCall investigate. Boxing turns deadly when the manager of promising fighter Sonny Ruiz and a doctor are both murdered. Hunter penetrates the world of prizefighting.

videos.title: Teen Dreams
videos.overview: Prostitutes are being murdered by a man who lures them disguised as a police officer. When McCall's friend Debbie Small (from the "City Under Siege" saga) returns to the profession, she may be the next target.

videos.title: Last Run
videos.overview: Hunter and McCall try to rescue an undercover female agent who was kidnapped during an investigation into money laundering, and have to deal with interference from the girl's father, who's a cop himself.

videos.title: Return of White Cloud
videos.overview: Hunter and McCall investigate the murder of an art gallery owner involved in illegal sales of Native American artifacts, and find themselves drawn into a mysterious world of Native American politics.

videos.title: On Air
videos.overview: Hunter becomes involved with a beautiful radio host when he goes undercover to catch a killer who threatens the men in her life.

videos.title: Shillelagh
videos.overview: Hunter and McCall are assigned to protect the Irish patriot brother of Devane's new lady friend, but find the man is the assassin instead of the intended victim.

videos.title: Investment in Death
videos.overview: Hunter and McCall pursue the killer of college student who was the brother of Hunter's old friend.

videos.title: A Girl Named Hunter
videos.overview: Hunter searches for the killer of a runaway girl whose baby he helped to deliver.

videos.title: The Legion (1)
videos.overview: Hunter defies departmental policy to save McCall from a kidnapper and bring her back to the police force.

videos.title: The Legion (2)
videos.overview: Hunter stalks the white supremacists who took McCall hostage; McCall considers leaving the force.

videos.title: Yesterday's Child
videos.overview: Hunter receives a life-altering shock when he is asked to take the case of a Vietnamese teenager who is accused of murdering a car salesman.

videos.title: Shield of Honor
videos.overview: Hunter's new trainee, the son of a career officer, has problems doing his duty as they investigate a series of robbery-murders.

videos.title: The Fifth Victim
videos.overview: Hunter and McCall track down a departmental leak in the investigation of a serial killer and his victims.

videos.title: Brotherly Love
videos.overview: Hunter and McCall investigate a teenager who accidentally kills a drug dealer and flees with the money, hoping to find the boy before the drug dealer's boss does.

videos.title: The Nightmare
videos.overview: Hunter and McCall pursue the killer of McCall's cleaning woman, a ruthless Central American doctor who brutally tortured the woman and her family many years before.

videos.title: Broken Dreams
videos.overview: An old flame of Hunter's witnesses a murder but withholds information while her husband blackmails the killer.

videos.title: Son and Heir
videos.overview: Hunter and McCall investigate a mobster's son who kills an undercover officer, unaware the cop is his half-brother.

videos.title: Unacceptable Loss
videos.overview: Hunter and McCall investigate the illegal disposal of poisonous gas that kills a young boy.

videos.title: Unfinished Business
videos.overview: Hunter and McCall's visit to a police psychiatrist regarding a work-related incident reveals a more intimate relationship years before.

videos.title: Lullaby
videos.overview: The investigation into the death of a British prostitute teams Hunter and McCall with a beautiful inspector from Scotland Yard.

videos.title: Final Confession
videos.overview: After serving a 20-year prison term, a convicted murderer hunts down his accomplices who avoided prosecution. One of the accomplices has since become a priest.

videos.title: Blind Ambition
videos.overview: When a young, convicted murderer commits suicide, his vengeful brother holds McCall and the judge she's dating captive, forcing McCall to discover the truth of the case.

videos.title: Sudden Withdrawal
videos.overview: Hunter and McCall search for a beautiful woman whose numerous liaisons are linked to a series of bank robberies.

videos.title: Second Sight
videos.overview: Hunter and McCall investigate a psychic's deadly premonitions.

videos.title: Street Wise (1)
videos.overview: As McCall rekindles an old romance, Hunter insinuates himself into a case involving the mysterious theft of a vagrant's Medal of Honor.

videos.title: Street Wise (2)
videos.overview: As an investigation into an elaborate fencing operation leads Hunter to the killer of a fellow officer and friend, McCall weighs the decision to marry and quit the force.

videos.title: Deadly Encounters (1)
videos.overview: Hunter teams with two Metro officers, one of whom is a former adversary, to locate the missing profits of a murdered black-marketeer as Devane considers a post in Metro.

videos.title: Deadly Encounters (2)
videos.overview: Hunter teams with two Metro officers, one of whom is a former adversary, to locate the missing profits of a murdered black-marketeer.

videos.title: Where Echoes End
videos.overview: Hunter attempts to clear the name of a fellow detective accused of a lucrative scheme.

videos.title: Kill Zone
videos.overview: Hunter and Molenski investigate a series of rape/murders that revive disturbing memories for Molenski

videos.title: The Incident
videos.overview: Hunter and Molenski battle a neighborhood watch group whose members are taking the law into their own hands.

videos.title: A Snitch'll Break Your Heart
videos.overview: Molenski battles with the department to protect the identity of an informant as Hunter investigates the death of an adopted boy.

videos.title: Oh, the Shark Bites!
videos.overview: When a mobster's son is killed, Devane must defend himself from charges of corruption.

videos.title: The Usual Suspects
videos.overview: Hunter leads a massive police operation to find dozens of prisoners set free by a computer operator who wants one of them to kill her husband.

videos.title: This is My Gun
videos.overview: While investigating a series of art thefts, Molenski's gun is stolen and used in a fatal robbery.

videos.title: La Familia
videos.overview: When a friend of Hunter's is released from prison, he struggles to keep his son from continuing gang activity.

videos.title: Acapulco Holiday
videos.overview: During the investigation of a series of robberies, Hunter clashes with an opportunistic lawyer when he arrests the wrong suspect.

videos.title: Fatal Obsession (1)
videos.overview: A former girlfriend complicates Hunter's investigation of a string of campus murders while Molenski becomes the target of a cop-killer.

videos.title: Fatal Obsession (2)
videos.overview: A former girlfriend complicates Hunter's investigation of a string of campus murders while Molenski becomes the target of a cop-killer.

videos.title: Under Suspicion
videos.overview: Hunter unwittingly helps a businessman find and kill a fleeing executive set to take the blame for the company's graft.

videos.title: The Reporter
videos.overview: Novak is pleased when old friend and national newspaper reporter Amy Rivers comes to Los Angeles to do a story on police work, until Amy's enthusiasm impedes an armed robbery investigation. Novak is puzzled by her friend's insensitive attitude until she learns of Amy's recently acquired cocaine dependence.

videos.title: Room Service
videos.overview: Old passions and jealousies flare when Hunter is forced to work with Chris Novak's ex-husband to solve a series of airport robberies while Chris tries to find an escaped prisoner she once arrested.

videos.title: Shadows of the Past
videos.overview: When Chris Novak's estranged father returns to her life, it's not to rekindle their relationship but to find and kill the only man who can expose his involvement in a drug ring.

videos.title: The Grab
videos.overview: Chris' daughter is kidnapped to prevent her father from providing Hunter and Chris with vital information on a killer and a counterfeit ring.

videos.title: All That Glitters
videos.overview: Hunter searches for the killer of several coin dealers while Novak is concerned about the arrest of a teenaged mugger who victimized her neighbor.

videos.title: Cries of Silence
videos.overview: As Hunter investigation the murder of a foreign dignitary's assistant, Novak searches for a runaway teenager who's linked to the killings.

videos.title: Ex Marks the Spot
videos.overview: A series of cleaning store robberies exposes the chain's owner as the decoy for a moneylaundering conspiracy and causes suspicion from his very dangerous partners.

videos.title: Little Man with a Big Reputation
videos.overview: Devane becomes entangled in the life of an ex-convict who disappears shortly before his wedding.

awards: Nominated for 3 Primetime Emmys. 2 wins & 7 nominations total
